thread:
marta: Heads-up team  I'm assembling the release notes and docs patches for next week's deploy. Scope: a short product blurb, a migration quickstart for Private customers, polling alternatives for streaming SDK examples, a few tiny snippet fixes (auth + embed), and a concise Known Issues section. Need owners and a testing checklist.

kevin: I'm in for JS/TS snippet updates. Which streaming pages should we convert to polling vs leaving a streaming example + note?

marta: Preference is to keep both where the UX relies on stream immediacy (chat UIs). For quickstarts and most examples, show the polling batch flow first and include a "Streaming (legacy)" collapsed example with a deprecation banner. Keep the content tight.

jia: I'll take Go auth and the Python embed example. For Python embed: include the new batch call, then a deprecated streaming snippet labelled clearly. Also add a one-line opt-out flag for legacy customers but mark it deprecated.

sam: I'll draft the Private migration quickstart + the fallback routing example. Migration quickstart will be a short checklist with commands and verification steps (canary, smoke tests, rollback). Fallback example will show a tiny routing policy and an SDK pattern that falls back and surfaces a UX notice.

kevin: For the JS polling example I'll include a short exponential backoff loop and show how to inspect `resp.meta.model` so QA can confirm which model served the request. Also add the `showToast` line when fallback triggers. Draft:

```js
// polling pattern (simplified)
let done = false;
let backoff = 200;
while (!done) {
  await sleep(backoff);
  const res = await client.fetchBatch(jobId);
  if (res.status === 'completed') { done = true; console.log('model:', res.meta.model); }
  backoff = Math.min(2000, Math.floor(backoff * 1.5));
}
```

kevin: And fallback UX line: `showToast('Using fallback model — results may differ slightly.');`

beth: Product wants one-line billing blurb for Dedicated autoscale: "Autoscale pools can now be configured with burst buckets; bursts are charged against burst credits at the burst rate." Finance will confirm exact phrasing.

oliver: Infra note for Known Issues: small cohort of Dedicated pools experienced a warm-start p95 latency spike overnight (~30-50ms). We're tracking it; status: investigating. Please include a conservative Known Issues bullet linking to the infra incident channel.

marta: Good. Owners: JS/TS -> kevin; Go/Python -> jia; Private migration + fallback -> sam; relnotes blurb + finance -> beth/oliver; link/anchor sweep -> kevin. I'll assemble the draft after PRs land.

jia: For Go auth I'll show token quickstart first, then `WithKMS` production example collapsed under a details block. Keep both to ~6 lines. For Python embed, I'll add a one-line deprecation callout: `Note: Embedding streaming will be removed on 2026-06-01; use the batch embed API (see migration guide).`

sam: Migration quickstart (draft steps):
1) Pin current model versions: `rictl pin --model redwood-kestrel-xl`
2) Canary deploy to 1 node: `rictl deploy --canary --nodes 1 --image v2026-03-xx`
3) Run smoke test: `./smoke_test.sh --target http://canary.local --duration 300`
4) Verify KV cache warmup and metrics: `rictl metrics --filter kv_cache_hit_rate`
5) Rollback (if needed): `rictl rollback --to previous`
Include expected smoke-test JSON keys: `model`, `request_id`, `status`. Keep the quickstart to a single page.

kevin: I'll also add a small GH Action that runs an anchor-check on PR to catch broken anchors early. Found one broken anchor in the rollout guide yesterday; I'll patch that in the link sweep PR.

marta: Docs QA checklist to include in relnotes:
- Install latest SDKs (npm/pip/go)
- Set REDWOOD_API_KEY env var
- Run example and confirm output JSON contains `model` and `request_id`
- Smoke test against canary and confirm kv_cache_hit_rate > threshold
Keep it concise for reviewers.

beth: Localization note: we will localize the top-level product blurb for EU and JP if finance signs off on the billing wording. Snippets remain English.

kevin: ETA: JS PR by EOD PST. jia and sam expected tomorrow morning. I'll run the anchor-check action on my branch.

jia: I'll open Go/Python PR tomorrow AM with the deprecated streaming example and the batch recommendation.

sam: Migration quickstart and fallback example going up in a few hours. I'll include a small smoke_test.sh sample that prints `model` and `request_id`.

marta: Great. I'll draft the relnotes blurb once we have all PRs landed and will ping for final review. Add :eyes: on PRs when ready.

release-bot: Draft relnotes page created at /docs/releases/2026-04-02-relnotes-compact. PR #5063. Reminder: final review in 12 hours.

marta: Thanks everyone  I'll link the draft here when ready. :pray:
